fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Arabia's Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has strengthened efforts to link accelerated regulatory pathways across the full drug development cycle, with a 20 business day process introduced for rare disease drug classification.
fields.summary_ko.1: SFDA and Singapore's Health Sciences Authority signed an MOU on September 14 to promote regulatory cooperation and information exchange, which could make international drug development and registration more efficient.
fields.summary_ko.2: Saudi CDMO company Lifera has signed MOUs with Pfizer, Sanofi, and MSD, building a biotech ecosystem through expanded clinical trial capabilities.
